title: Statistics for Healthcare
description: Probability and statistics for analysing health data, from describing samples to hypothesis tests, plus a first introduction to regression and causal inference. Workshops use Stata.
assessment: Written exam at the end of the course. AI tools are not allowed.
textbooks: Folland, S., Goodman, A. C. & Stano, M. The Economics of Health and Health Care, ch. 3 'Statistical Tools for Health Economics'.
Bertsekas, D. & Tsitsiklis, J. (2008). Introduction to Probability, ch. 1. Athena Scientific.
Altman, D. (1991). Practical Statistics for Medical Research. Chapman and Hall.
